name: Honest Abe
bio: Four score and seven rounds ago. Has never told a lie about a headshot.
notes: The owner's own Meshy model (Drive folder, 2026-11-01, second batch): made and rigged in Meshy (the All Animations GLB; its clips are not used). Its rig names its joints the Mixamo way (mixamorig:Hips ...), read as Meshy's. Abraham Lincoln in a stovepipe hat, frock coat and waistcoat.
